label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
note: Deterministic bridge only. Excludes LLM prompt engineering, evaluation, and utility testing (out of scope for this spec).

milestones.name: Author + freeze the concern ontology
milestones.notes: the load-bearing new degree of freedom; author a closed set with inclusion/exclusion criteria; freeze by hash.

milestones.name: Author + freeze the concern->concept table
milestones.deliverable: concept_mapping.json conforming to concept_mapping.schema.json, bound to the ontology hash
milestones.notes: one canonical Sanskrit concept per concern; deterministic selection_rule; candidates recorded for audit.

milestones.name: Deterministic core implementation
milestones.deliverable: bridge_core: concern-id -> concept (table) -> frozen parser -> frozen v3 lexicon -> mapping glosses
milestones.notes: reuses the frozen parser + lexicon UNCHANGED; fully deterministic + unit-tested; no model calls.

milestones.name: Confidence + abstention layer
milestones.notes: Tier-1 mappings (d,s,v,y) and relationship families (opposition,no_relationship) preferred.

milestones.name: Extraction + synthesis adapters (interface only)
milestones.deliverable: typed I/O contracts for stage-1 extraction and stage-6 synthesis (NO prompts specified here)
milestones.notes: extraction constrained to select from the frozen ontology; synthesis constrained by the allowed/forbidden contribution list.
